pcs.pc_description: arrange the necessary lab equipment, personal protective equipment (PPE)
set up laboratory with the required instructional materials and supplies for the research project
examine the PPE and clothing for any wear and tear or damage
apply disinfectant on the relevant lab areas to remove all bacteria/ micro-organisms
ensure the room for incubating cultures has the relevant equipment to control temperature, light and humidity
test the computer system for correct functioning to record the relevant data
ensure the availability of washing area, workbenches and safe storage of lab equipment
dispose any expired chemicals as per the Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)
remove all consumables and flammable items from the lab

modules.module_title: Calibrate and maintain the lab equipment

pcs.pc_description: identify the relevant lab equipment to be used in the plant tissue culture activities
follow the laboratory procedures while handling lab tools, equipment, dead weights, calibrated measuring jars and reagents
calibrate equipment in accordance with the tolerances prescribed by the manufacturer
apply label on the lab equipment to identify the calibrated equipment
co-ordinate with the manufacturer for the calibration of equipment requiring expert assistance
check the working and performance of all equipment on a regular basis
report any malfunctions/ repair needs to the supervisor
co-ordinate with the maintenance service provider to ensure maintenance of all lab equipment
maintain the relevant lab-equipment records such as their performance, faults, repair, annual maintenance, etc.
maintain the inventory of lab supplies by checking the stock regularly
order the lab supplies when required
verify the receipt of lab supplies
maintain stock buffer of reagents and microbiological media

modules.module_title: Prepare the plant tissue culture medium

pcs.pc_description: identify the appropriate culture medium along with its nature, composition and suitability for the selected explants
use the recommended grade of lab chemicals and agar for the preparation of culture medium
use double glass distilled, Reverse Osmosis (RO) or demineralised water in culture medium
prepare different stock solutions as nutrient medium with the required constituents, strength and volume

ensure the availability of deep freezer to store stock solutions; refrigerator to store chemicals, short-term storage for stock solutions; storage tank for distilled water and other equipment such as electronic weighing balance, hot plates, Potential of Hydrogen (pH) meter, etc.
store or refrigerate the stock solutions at the recommended temperature after applying appropriate labels on them
prepare culture medium such as MS, B5, N6, Nitsch and Whites using the recommended quantity of sucrose, agar, water and stock solution with the help of hot plate and magnetic stirrer
adjust the pH of the culture medium to the required level using HCl and NaOH (hydrochloric acid and sodium hydroxide) solution
dispense medium uniformly into culture bottles/ tubes manually or with the help of automatic media dispenser
apply label with the relevant information on the culture bottles/ tubes
maintain the record of prepared culture medium in the media register or relevant computer system

modules.module_title: Sterilise and store the culture medium

pcs.pc_description: sterilise the media at the prescribed temperature and pressure for an appropriate duration in an autoclave
sterilise the syntax filters before use
carry out filtration sterilisation of the stock solutions through a syntax filter
dispense the filter sterilised solution in the autoclaved media after cooling under aseptic conditions
transfer the culture bottles to media storage room immediately after autoclaving
check the culture medium for microbial contamination after autoclaving and discard the entire lot along with the culture bottles in case contamination is found to be above the prescribed limit

modules.module_title: Prepare the mother plant and explant

pcs.pc_description: identify the crops and plants that can undergo micro-propagation such as fruits, vegetables, food grain crops, ornamental plants, etc.
select the mother plant which appear healthy and are free from pests, diseases and bacterial infections
ensure that the mother plants are grown in a greenhouse wherever possible
expose the mother plants to recommended temperature and sunlight to improve the quality of explants
pre-treat the mother plant with recommended fungicides where possible to prevent bacterial contamination
water the plants with the recommended quantity of filtered water
apply a label on the mother plant container with the relevant details such as the name and type of the plant, the location and date of extraction, etc.
pack the mother plant appropriately in cardboard cartons or immersed water
transport the mother plant to the culture laboratory safely under the recommended temperature
maintain the plant in a sterilised environment prior to use
use the relevant tools to extract the explant from the sterilised mother plant
sterilise the explant using the prescribed sterilisation solution

modules.module_title: Prepare for transferring the explant to culture medium

pcs.pc_description: cut the explant into pieces of the prescribed length
wash the plant pieces using the recommended cleaning agent
transfer the plant parts into containers with Clorox solution and soak them for the recommended duration
discard the Clorox solution as per the SOP
maintain the plant parts in the container under the recommended temperature

modules.module_title: Transfer the explant to culture medium

pcs.pc_description: sterilise the relevant equipment and containers using an alcohol-based disinfectant
pour sterile water into the container with the plant parts
shake the container gently after placing a sterile lid to wash the tissue and remove the sterilising solution
place the plant parts using sterilised gloves on a sterile petri dish after removing from the container
cut the plant parts into smaller pieces of the recommended length using a sterilised blade
discard the damaged plant parts safely
place the plant pieces into the culture bottles/ tubes containing culture medium using sterile forceps
place cap on the culture bottles/ tubes tightly
store the culture bottles/ tubes in trays or storage racks safely
maintain the appropriate conditions in the lab such as temperature, humidity and illumination for the multiplication of plant tissues
add cytokinin to the culture medium as per the requirement to regulate the growth of plant shoots
monitor the plant shoots regularly for the correct growth and any contaminations
discard the contaminated plant shoots as per the SOP
transfer the proliferated shoots to fresh culture medium for mass multiplication
place the shoots in another nutrient culture medium specific for root development
add auxins in the recommended quantity to promote root formation
monitor the development of roots
apply the necessary treatment to resolve any issues with root development
maintain the record of observations in the register or the relevant computer system
select a facility with the appropriate temperature and humidity favourable for the plants
remove the plantlets from culture bottles/ tubes after they achieve adequate growth and rooting
wash the plantlets gently to remove any traces of culture media
plant the tissue cultured plants in micro-pots filled with soil/ soilrite/ sand for primary hardening
label the plants with the necessary information
apply water and fertilizers in the recommended quantity as per the schedule
maintain the plants in the facility for the recommended duration before hardening off
place the plants in a greenhouse or shade net facility with controlled micro-climatic conditions such as relative humidity, temperature, light intensity and air circulation
transfer the plants to larger pots for secondary hardening after they develop new leaves and roots
maintain the level of nutrients for the optimum growth of plants
conduct routine checks on the plantlets to ensure their healthy growth and detect presence of any infections
remove the dead and decaying plants
maintain the plants in the environment for the recommended period before transplanting

pcs.pc_description: select a spot with adequate exposure to sunlight
prepare the planting bed in a greenhouse or select larger pots of appropriate size for transplanting the plants
create holes of the recommended width and depth to place the plants
water the potted plants to loosen the soil around their roots
extract the plants from the pots ensuring no damage to plants and their roots
place the plants in the holes and cover the roots with the soil
apply the recommended amount of fertilizers and water
arrange to protect the transplanted plants from excessive heat and cold
maintain the plants in the recommended temperature and humidity
apply necessary treatment if the transplanted plants show signs of wilting, pests and disease

pcs.pc_description: use the appropriate computer application to maintain the record of lab operations in the prescribed format
review the data regularly to ensure accuracy
comply with the applicable regulatory record keeping requirements
optimise the usage of various material in different tasks/ activities/ processes
optimise the usage of electricity/ water/ energy in various tasks/ activities/ processes
connect the electrical tools and equipment safely and turn off when not in use
segregate waste into different categories
dispose the non-recyclable waste appropriately
deposit the recyclable and reusable material at the identified location
